goon.contact.tess.name: Tess Navarro
goon.contact.tess.personality: Practical, dry, and protective of other workers' time. An honest refusal beats an impossible promise.
goon.contact.tess.need: Cover a small repair roster and help prepare the cooperative's shared room.
goon.contact.tess.knowledge: Her own shifts, the cooperative account, and promises made to her.

goon.contact.cal.name: Cal Mercer
goon.contact.cal.role: Neighborhood runner and criminal work contact
goon.contact.cal.personality: Talks confidently about other people's plans; records his own work and pay with unusual care.
goon.contact.cal.need: Find a reliable affiliated worker for a local collection referral.
goon.contact.cal.knowledge: Terms he disclosed and the results of his own referrals.

opening_shift.speaker: goon.contact.tess
opening_shift.title: A place on the repair roster
opening_shift.situation: The store has one funded repair shift. Tess needs a worker, not a declaration of lifelong loyalty.

options.label: Work the repair shift
options.tradeoff: $20 guaranteed from the store's roster; one action and this shift slot.

options.label: Decline this shift
options.tradeoff: No wage; later local work remains possible.

promise.speaker: goon.contact.tess
promise.title: A promise with an actual date
promise.situation: Tess asks for help setting up the cooperative's shared room on the second morning. There is no pay. She can use an honest answer.

options.label: Promise to help on the second morning
options.tradeoff: Reserve a personal commitment; keeping it later costs one action and the morning slot.

options.label: Say you cannot promise that
options.tradeoff: No promise, reward, or penalty. Lawful work remains open.

cal_intro.speaker: goon.contact.cal
cal_intro.title: Cal's account of the work
cal_intro.situation: Cal has a collection referral for somebody already affiliated. He will explain the terms if you ask; he cannot promise that the police will look away.

options.label: Ask Cal about the referral
options.tradeoff: Learn his terms. No gang membership or money is granted.

options.label: Leave Cal's work alone
options.tradeoff: No referral this window; other neighborhood opportunities remain.

crossroads.speaker: player
crossroads.title: One morning, several demands
crossroads.situation: The repair shift, Cal's local pickup, and the cooperative favor share the same morning roster slot. Choose one commitment; other daily actions remain usable elsewhere.

options.label: Take the lawful repair shift
options.tradeoff: $20 guaranteed; the other morning commitments are forgone.

options.label: Try the collection job through Cal
options.tradeoff: Existing collection rules: up to $60, heat, possible witnesses/case, and faction consequences. No guaranteed success.

options.label: Keep the promise to Tess
options.tradeoff: No money. Keep the dated promise and earn a personal reference.

options.label: Ask to move the favor to the fourth morning
options.tradeoff: Move it once; forgo this morning's work. A later shift can still conflict.

options.label: Leave the morning uncommitted
options.tradeoff: No wage or free recovery. Any accepted promise still has its deadline.

midweek_shift.speaker: goon.contact.tess
midweek_shift.title: The fourth-morning shift
midweek_shift.situation: The store has another funded shift. It conflicts with a favor moved to this same morning.

options.label: Work the repair shift
options.tradeoff: $20; one action and the fourth-morning slot.

options.label: Pass on this shift
options.tradeoff: No wage; keep the time for another commitment.

late_work.speaker: player
late_work.title: A little flexibility late in the week
late_work.situation: Your known offers compete for one prearranged late-week roster slot, usable on either of the next two days. Choose one commitment; the store and Cal pay through their own separate rules.

options.label: Take a regular repair shift
options.tradeoff: $20; one action. No reference required.

options.label: Use Tess's reference for the stock audit
options.tradeoff: $25; two actions for the more involved audit. Needs Tess's standing at least 2 and uses this offer's only allocation.

options.label: Try Cal's quieter courier referral
options.tradeoff: Existing courier rules: up to $25, failure risk and faction effects; no new collection case. Needs Cal's standing at least 1.

options.label: Leave the allocation for someone else
options.tradeoff: No money or standing reward; next week's basic work remains available.

rescheduled_help.speaker: goon.contact.tess
rescheduled_help.title: The favor you moved
rescheduled_help.situation: Tess kept the fourth morning free after your request. This is the new date, not a second favor reward.

options.label: Keep the rescheduled promise
options.tradeoff: No wage; fulfill the original promise and earn its reference once.

options.label: Say you will not make it
options.tradeoff: Close the promise honestly; Tess remembers the broken commitment.

room_review.speaker: goon.contact.tess
room_review.title: Keeping the room workable
room_review.situation: The cooperative keeps basic room access during a shortfall. It offers one small maintenance credit per review; it does not pay cash or stack late fees.

options.label: Do one maintenance task against the balance
options.tradeoff: One action reduces existing arrears by up to $10; no cash or friendship points.

options.label: Keep the grace arrangement for now
options.tradeoff: The bounded unpaid balance remains. Home and local work remain accessible.
